required_fixes: RF1-STATUS-OUTCOME: result.json status=COMPLETE / outcome=FALSIFIES is not what the frozen decision rule produces from the frozen booleans. spec.json decision_rule.outcome_mapping routes "null_power_NOT_demonstrated OR substrate_failure OR code_path_violated" to MEASUREMENT_INVALID, and the packet's own metrics record IVC_GROUND_TRUTH_COMPLETE=false and per-case IVC_MIN_PERMUTATION_P_KB-*=1.0 (i.e. null_power_demonstrated=false, which result.json observations[6] states verbatim). run_experiment.py:374-386 evaluates the FALSIFIES branch before the MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch, so the MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch is dead code, and the re-ordering was never disclosed in result.json validity_notes or unresolved. Re-code the outcome under the frozen mapping, or record explicitly which precedence governs and why.

RF2-DISCLOSE-RULE-CONFLICT: the frozen packet is internally inconsistent about this exact condition. spec.json falsifier lists "the null calibration of the contract itself lacks demonstrated power (minimum attainable permutation p >= 0.01 on any known-bad case)" as a falsifier disjunct; spec.json decision_rule.rules[6] (FALSIFIES) precedes rules[7] (MEASUREMENT_INVALID) on the same facts; prereg.md section 8 fixes "Gate Evaluation Order: G5, G6, G7 (infrastructure) -> G1, G2 (contract validity) -> G3, G4 (scientific outcome)", which routes G2-FAIL and G6-FAIL to MEASUREMENT_INVALID ahead of G3/G4. The producer resolved this ambiguity silently in the direction that avoids MEASUREMENT_INVALID. State the conflict in the packet and state the precedence applied.

RF3-G6-FALSE-ALARM: IVC_GROUND_TRUTH_COMPLETE=false is a defect in the checker, not a substrate failure, and it is currently the trigger for a MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch. The predicate at run_experiment.py:315 is len(ground_truth) == N_TRAJECTORIES * N_STEPS = 2000, but the log holds 2200 rows = 200 trajectories x 11 contiguous steps (auditor recomputation: every trajectory carries steps 0..10, 200/200). The extra row per trajectory is the runner's own priming request at run_experiment.py:112-114. Correct the predicate or the sample-size declaration; do not leave a substrate-failure signal generated by an off-by-one.

RF4-SAMPLE-SIZE-DEVIATION: prereg.md section 9 declares 4,000 transitions (200 x 10 x 2 regimes) and 1,000 permutations per channel over 4 channels. Realised: 2,200 transitions, 1,000 permutations, and exactly one channel per case. Neither the 2,200 vs 4,000 shortfall nor the 1-of-4-channel execution appears in result.json validity_notes, and result.json unresolved is [].

RF5-ALIGNMENT-METRIC-ABSENT: spec.json measurement_validity[3] IVC-SERVER-GROUND-TRUTH requires "ground_truth_complete == True AND alignment_verified == True". No alignment_verified metric exists anywhere in result.json.metrics, and no artifact contains the prereg.md section 4.5 "post-execution audit comparing contract-internal MI values against independent ground-truth recomputation". A frozen validity criterion was left unreported rather than reported as failed.

RF6-EXACT-CODEX-STATISTICS-NOT-USED: prereg.md section 5.1 ("Use the EXACT code from the Codex artifact. Do not re-implement"), section 10 ("Use EXACT Codex artifact hashes for all 3 known-bad estimators") and request.json director_mandate.allocation.dependencies.codex ("must use the exact statistics recorded in the Codex ... not re-implementations of them") were all violated. KB-PHYSICS-CMI is a fresh re-implementation in estimators.py:32-115; the retrievable Codex artifact research/experiments/EXP-PHYSICS-36279239922/execute_calibration_v3.py (sha256 19e44d27bc6b089a3a5297396c1bb97887cf6f65c74cf211a4555ab6570bc0e4, exactly the hash prereg.md section 5.1 cites) was neither imported nor hash-verified. KB-PRODUCT-COLD and KB-FRONTIER-GOAL were specified as computed quantities (prereg.md 5.2 amortized_cost_ratio = treatment_cost / cold_cost; 5.3 goal_state_success = all(steps.expected_code AND final_store_empty)) and were implemented as `return 1.0` (estimators.py:147, 164).

RF7-DEGENERATE-BATTERY: four of the nine cases are constant functions (KB-PRODUCT-COLD, KB-FRONTIER-GOAL return 1.0; B-NULL-INSTRUMENT, NC-CONSTANT-ZERO return 0.0), PC-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD is a one-line wrapper around KG-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD (estimators.py:322-324), and B-NULL-INSTRUMENT and NC-CONSTANT-ZERO are the same function. The auditor counts 5 distinct estimator behaviours across 9 case slots. Rejecting constants is not the documented failure mode; the battery contains no non-constant blind statistic, so G3-KNOWN-BAD-REJECT carries almost no discriminating content.

RF8-POSITIVE-CONTROL-NOT-THE-PREREGISTERED-ESTIMATOR: prereg.md section 6.1 requires the Runtime header-only Jaccard discrimination estimator. estimators.py:171-204 instead returns I(treatment; target | regime, action) in bits, and no Jaccard computation exists anywhere in the packet (the two header helpers _simulate_headers_from_treatment / _simulate_headers are dead code, 0 call sites). PC-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD is therefore not a positive control for the preregistered claim. The G4 false-positive branch ("Known-good estimator classified as REJECT -> FALSIFIES") was therefore never evaluated against a Codex-validated estimator. Separately, PC and KG are the same callable on the same data and channel yet produced different deltas (1.7711598936776587 vs 1.771066334482052), which is direct evidence that the contract's numerics depend on shared-RNG call order rather than on the case.

RF9-CODE-PATH-CONTROL-VACUOUS: InterventionValidityContract._compute_code_path_hash hashes inspect.getsource(self.evaluate) once in __init__ and stamps the same digest on every ContractResult, so IVC_IDENTICAL_CODE_PATH_VERIFIED=true is a tautology that cannot fail. prereg.md section 4.4 requires hashing evaluate.__code__.co_code and explicitly forbids estimator-specific branching, yet run_experiment.py:245-249 selects the evaluation channel by estimator id (all expected-REJECT cases on CH-SHUFFLED, all expected-ACCEPT cases on CH-IDENTITY), which is exactly the special-casing the control was meant to detect and which the hash cannot see.

RF10-CHANNELS-NOT-PREREGISTERED-AND-NULL-NOT-NULL: prereg.md sections 4.3, 10 and 12 require channel MI measured from ground truth and recorded BEFORE freeze, with CH-IDENTITY = H(latent) = log2(8) = 3.0 and CH-SHUFFLED = 0.0. Realised values are 1.9491083554306654 and 0.1880049864679197, written to preregistered_channels.json at execute time, so the acceptance threshold delta >= MI_c was adjudicated against a post-hoc measured quantity. CH-SHUFFLED is not a zero-information baseline: a global (not within-stratum) permutation of the latent still yields I(R; state_after | regime, action) = 0.16575614127138782 bits (auditor recomputation), so roughly 0.17 bits of the 0.188 is finite-sample plug-in bias. CH-PARTIAL-0.5 (0.6250) and CH-PARTIAL-0.1 (0.1964) were computed and stored but never evaluated against any case.

RF11-INVARIANCE-NOT-AS-PREREGISTERED-AND-WITHOUT-POWER: prereg.md section 4.2 step 6 and spec.json measurement_validity[0] require bitwise equality; the implementation uses np.isclose with default rtol=1e-5 (intervention_validity_contract.py:145). More materially, on this substrate the within-stratum permutation is the identity by construction: strata are keyed by (regime_before, state_before, action) (intervention_validity_contract.py:72) and the treatment IS state_before, so the treatment is constant inside every stratum. Auditor recomputation: 0 of 80 strata change their (T,Y) pair multiset under within-stratum permutation, and stat_original == stat_permuted bitwise for both kg_runtime_header_jaccard and an unconditional I(T;Y) estimator. IVC-METAMORPHIC-INVARIANCE therefore has zero power here; its single failure (B-SHUFFLED-CHANNEL) is a pooled Pearson correlation compared against a bits-valued threshold, i.e. a units artifact.

RF12-G2-UNSATISFIABLE-AS-WRITTEN: for any constant statistic all 1,000 permutation draws equal the observed value, so perm_deltas are all 0, n_exceed = 1000 and p = 1001/1001 = 1.0 identically (auditor recomputation for both `return 0.0` and `return 1.0`). prereg.md G2-DISPLACEMENT-POWER ("min_permutation_p < 0.01 on ALL known-bad estimators") is therefore unsatisfiable for the battery as frozen, and prereg.md section 4.3's "minimum attainable permutation p" conflates the test's resolution floor (1/1001 = 0.000999) with a per-estimator p-value under the metric name IVC_MIN_PERMUTATION_P_[ESTIMATOR_ID]. result.json observations[6] correctly records "Null power demonstrated (p<0.01): False" and then the packet does not act on the gate that observation maps to. Either the gate or the metric must be restated; as frozen, G2 carries no information about contract power.

RF13-G1-OMITTED-FROM-GATE-TABLE: G1-INVARIANCE is FAIL (B-SHUFFLED-CHANNEL invariance_passed=false) and prereg.md section 8 maps G1 failure to MEASUREMENT_INVALID (contract defect), but report.md's Gate Evaluation table lists only G2-G7. Audited G1 verdict: FAIL.

RF14-ACCEPT-BRANCH-UNREACHABLE-AND-SCALE-DEPENDENT: the frozen criterion (prereg.md 4.3 step 3, implemented at intervention_validity_contract.py:209) is delta_statistic >= channel_MI_c, where delta_statistic = |stat_test - E_null[stat]| is in the estimator's own units and channel_MI_c is in bits. For any unbiased estimator of the channel's conditional MI this reduces to delta = MI_c - E_null < MI_c whenever E_null > 0, so ACCEPT is unreachable. Auditor recomputation: stat_test = 1.9491083554306654 = MI_c, E_null = 0.1782223538506356, delta = 1.7708860015800298, margin 0.1782 bits, required inflation 1.1006x. Scale factors 0.5, 0.9 and 0.99 of the same estimator all yield REJECT. The criterion can only be satisfied by an over-scaled statistic, i.e. it selects for miscalibration. Report this as the identified mechanism of the 9/9 REJECT instead of as a property of the estimators.

RF15-NO-INTERVENTION-IN-SUBSTRATE: treatment is not assigned, it is a covariate. run_experiment.py:160-161 sets treatment = latent_state_before and target = latent_state_after, latent_state_before == state_before in 2200/2200 rows, latent_state_after == state_after in 2200/2200 rows, and state_after = (state_before + action_idx + 1) mod 8 in 1137/1137 deterministic-regime rows. The "channel" is a relabeling of the current state, not a randomized assignment, so the packet contains no intervention and the contract was never tested against one. The client-side HTTP observations collected in run_trajectories (response headers, status codes, bodies) are never consumed by any estimator and are not persisted, so prereg.md section 11 "Full HTTP request/response pairs logged" was not delivered and the mandate's "real locally-served multi-page HTTP data" condition is not exercised by any measured quantity.

RF16-G7-FLAGS-HARDCODED: IVC_NO_EXTERNAL_DEPS and IVC_BROWSER_FREE are assigned the literal True at run_experiment.py:320-321 with no check, and report.md prints G7 PASS unconditionally. prereg.md section 3.3 specifies "Stdlib + nginx + SQLite only"; the executed code imports numpy 2.5.3 (used) and scipy 1.18.1 (estimators.py, intervention_validity_contract.py; provenance.json records no scipy version), and nginx was dropped (correctly disclosed in validity_notes). The no-credential / no-browser substance holds; the "stdlib-only" statement does not.

RF17-TRACEABILITY: result.json artifacts entries carry no sha256 (EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 4 prefers path+sha256+role), provenance.json records no artifact hashes, and provenance.json git.commit = f79f14729c4239cb7d7e9539294a8417f65f0fe3 is the pre-execution base; the code that produced these results is in commit a612511a. Add artifact hashes and the executed commit.

RF18-REPORT-ARITHMETIC: report.md line 16 states "200 x 10 steps = 2200 transitions" (200 x 10 = 2000), and the verdict-match marker is concatenated into the last table column without a separator on every row of the IVC Evaluation Results table.
validity_findings: V1-DECODED: OBSERVED (result.json metrics, report.md) IVC_GROUND_TRUTH_COMPLETE=false, IVC_IDENTICAL_CODE_PATH_VERIFIED=true, and per-case IVC_MIN_PERMUTATION_P_*=1.0 for the three known-bad cases. DERIVED (auditor, run_experiment.py:374-386 vs spec.json decision_rule.outcome_mapping): with all_bad_rejected=true, any_good_accepted=false, null_power_demonstrated=false, identical_path_verified=true, substrate_ok=false, the frozen mapping's FALSIFIES key ("ANY_known_bad_ACCEPT OR known_good_REJECT") and its MEASUREMENT_INVALID key ("null_power_NOT_demonstrated OR substrate_failure OR code_path_violated") are both satisfied. The producer selected FALSIFIES; the mapping is a flat key/value table with no precedence, and the producer's code imposes a precedence that the frozen artifact does not. FINDING: the packet's reported status/outcome is not reproducible from the frozen decision rule and the deviation is undisclosed. This is a transmission defect, not a scientific result.

V2-OUTCOME-PREDETERMINED: DERIVED (auditor recomputation, /tmp copy of the packet code on the packet's own artifacts): for the frozen criterion delta >= MI_c with a calibrated estimator of I(R;Y|C), ACCEPT is arithmetically unreachable because delta = MI_c - E_null[I] and E_null[I] = 0.1782223538506356 > 0 on this data. The margin is 0.1782 bits and the required over-scaling is 1.1006x. The known-good KG-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD returned exactly the channel MI (1.9491083554306654), i.e. it was perfectly calibrated, and was still REJECTed. All 9/9 REJECT is therefore a property of the frozen criterion, not evidence about any estimator. Any FALSIFIES reading that attributes the outcome to estimator quality is unsupported.

V3-TEST-ANTAGONISM: the frozen contract requires, for ACCEPT, both (a) bitwise invariance of the statistic to within-stratum permutation of the treatment (prereg.md 4.2) and (b) displacement of the statistic when the treatment is re-drawn through a channel (prereg.md 4.3). Property (b) is a demand for treatment sensitivity and (a) is a demand for treatment insensitivity. The pair is not jointly satisfiable in general; the observed pattern (8/9 invariance passes with 0/9 displacements) is what a contract with mutually antagonistic acceptance conditions must produce. The producer did not identify or disclose this.

V4-INVARIANCE-TAUTOLOGY: DERIVED (auditor): strata are keyed by (regime_before, state_before, action) and treatment == state_before, so treatment is constant within every stratum and within-stratum permutation is the identity; 0/80 strata change their (T,Y) multiset. Verified bitwise: stat_original == stat_permuted == 1.9491083554306654 for kg_runtime_header_jaccard, and == 0.2110469908051161 for an unconditional I(T;Y) estimator. IVC-METAMORPHIC-INVARIANCE has no power on this substrate and its spec criterion (bitwise_equality) was not implemented (np.isclose, rtol=1e-5).

V5-NO-POWER-DEMONSTRATION: the mandate's central requirement is "a validity test whose null calibration is demonstrated to have power against the specific failure it must detect". No case in the battery demonstrates contract power against a non-constant blind statistic, and the metric offered as evidence of power (IVC_MIN_PERMUTATION_P_*) is 1.0 by construction for constants. The producer's own observation "Null power demonstrated (p<0.01): False" is the correct reading, but the packet simultaneously reports FALSIFIES, so the power failure is recorded and then not acted upon.

V6-RNG-ORDER-DEPENDENCE: DERIVED (auditor): InterventionValidityContract holds one shared np.random.default_rng(44) consumed by test_invariance and then 1,000 draws in test_channel_displacement, so per-case numerics depend on evaluation order and are not independently reproducible. The producer's own artifact shows this: PC-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD and KG-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD are the same callable on the same data and the same channel yet report 1.7711598936776587 and 1.771066334482052. A fresh-contract recomputation of KG gives 1.7708728340182118. prereg.md section 4 calls the contract "single deterministic" and section 10 claims fixed seeds and determinism; per-case reproducibility is not established and no per-case seed is recorded.

V7-CHANNEL-THRESHOLD-SELECTED-POST-HOC: the acceptance threshold is the post-freeze measured channel MI, not the pre-registered value (1.9491 vs 3.0 for CH-IDENTITY; 0.1880 vs 0.0 for CH-SHUFFLED). The mismatch does not change this run's verdicts (KG fails under either threshold), but the packet's central instrument-certification mechanism is a threshold that was materialised after freeze and is compared in mismatched units. prereg.md sections 4.3, 10 and 12 each require pre-registration before freeze; preregistered_channels.json carries no pre-freeze timestamp and was written by run_experiment.py during the measured run.

V8-NO-INTERVENTION: DERIVED (auditor): treatment = latent_state_before = state_before (2200/2200) and target = latent_state_after = state_after (2200/2200); state_after is a deterministic function of (state_before, action_idx) in 1137/1137 deterministic rows. There is no randomized assignment in the substrate, so the experiment measures a covariate's information content under relabeling, not the validity of an estimator with respect to an intervention. The physics lane charter requires an "operational mathematical object, observable, falsifier, strong nulls and identifiability argument"; the object here (a channel-displacement threshold) is operational, but there is no intervention to be valid with respect to.

V9-SUBSTRATE-NOT-EXERCISED: client-side HTTP evidence exists transiently (run_experiment.py:125-140 collects status, headers, body) but is returned as client_data and never read again; prepare_estimator_data (run_experiment.py:148-163) builds the estimator input entirely from server-side ground-truth rows. No estimator consumes an HTTP response. ground_truth_log.jsonl contains only (id, trajectory_id, step, state_before/after, regime_before/after, action, action_idx, url_before/after, timestamp, latent_state_before/after) and no method, headers, body or status, so the raw HTTP evidence prereg.md section 11 promised is absent from the packet.

V10-BATTERY-VS-PREREG-COVERAGE: 2 of 4 preregistered channels (CH-PARTIAL-0.5, CH-PARTIAL-0.1) were computed, stored and never used; prereg.md section 6.1's requirement that KG "responds to CH-IDENTITY and CH-PARTIAL-0.5 with delta >= MI, p < 0.01" was therefore only half-executed, and it is the half that failed. KB-PHYSICS-CMI, KB-PRODUCT-COLD, KB-FRONTIER-GOAL, B-NULL-INSTRUMENT, B-SHUFFLED-CHANNEL and NC-CONSTANT-ZERO were each evaluated on CH-SHUFFLED only; the three expected-ACCEPT cases were each evaluated on CH-IDENTITY only (run_experiment.py:245-249). The code comment at run_experiment.py:240-242 ("But we test all channels for completeness") is false.

V11-CODEX-CONSISTENCY: the defect pattern this experiment was mandated to cure is itself reproduced. codex/claim_state.json records for EXP-PHYSICS-36279239922 that a previous Physics packet's null control was "affirmatively non-discriminating, returning p_bonf 1.0 ... so its G1 PASS carries no validity information" and that its positive control was not a positive control. Here NC-CONSTANT-ZERO and B-NULL-INSTRUMENT are the same constant function (p = 1.0 by construction, so its REJECT carries no information about the contract), and PC-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD is a wrapper around the known-good (so it adds no independent case). The mandate dependency that the known-bad battery use the exact Codex statistics was not honoured, so the packet does not test the three documented estimators at all.

V12-POSITIVE-CONTROL-PROVENANCE: prereg.md section 6.1 designates KG-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD from EXP-RUNTIME-36100549580 as VALIDATED. codex/index.json records that packet as audit_status PASS with decision "SUPPORTS - DISTRIBUTED VALIDATED canonical shared-WAL real-cache gate (C-MEAS-VALID) on plain HTTP localhost", but codex/claim_state.json latest_event_by_claim.C-MEAS-VALID is MEASUREMENT_INVALID (from EXP-PHYSICS-36279239922), and the packet directory research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-36100549580 is not present in this worktree (accepted Codex copy at codex/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-36100549580). The quoted success statistics (mean 0.4643, var 0.0958, std 0.3095, r_sched 0.0087, V 0.0379, same_state_J 1.0, nullFP 0.0) are recorded in the Codex as reproduced by a function that codex/claim_state.json describes as hardcoding r=0.0087, V=0.037, same_state_J=1.0 and nullFP=0.0. The positive control's VALIDATED designation is therefore bounded to a plain-HTTP cache-discrimination gate on one substrate, and no part of that certification was carried into the estimator actually executed here.

V13-GATE-TABLE-SELECTIVE: report.md's Gate Evaluation section reports G2, G3, G4, G5, G6, G7 and omits G1, which is FAIL. Audited G1 verdict: FAIL (B-SHUFFLED-CHANNEL invariance_passed=false). prereg.md section 8 maps G1 failure to MEASUREMENT_INVALID (contract defect). The omission is not recorded in validity_notes or unresolved.

V14-UNRESOLVED-EMPTY: result.json unresolved is [] and report.md Unresolved is "None.", yet the packet carries at minimum: a failed G1, a failed G2, a failed G6, an unmet alignment_verified criterion, a 2,200-vs-4,000 sample deviation, 2 unused preregistered channels, a re-implemented Codex statistic, a substituted positive control and a hardcoded G7. Per EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 4, unresolved records questions the producer cannot settle from this run; these are such questions.

V15-REPRODUCIBILITY-POSITIVE: the producer's reported numbers are faithful. Auditor re-execution of the packet's own code against the packet's own artifacts reproduced all 9 IVC_DELTA_STATISTIC_*, all 9 IVC_MIN_PERMUTATION_P_*, all 9 invariance/displacement flags and IVC_CODE_PATH_HASH = 6afce2f1bc17196934ec6ce650b1c9f769e0dcf5b3c702f25b8e1f38839f14ea exactly (bitwise). Frozen inputs are intact: sha256 of request.json, spec.json and prereg.md match freeze.json exactly. The worktree for this experiment is clean against HEAD a612511a. Nothing here indicates fabrication; the defect is in what the design could express and in what was reported.

V16-ENVIRONMENT: no infrastructure failure occurred. stdlib http.server started, 2,200 transitions were logged and served over real HTTP on localhost:18888, and no credential, container registry or browser was used or needed. model_audit.json records a transient retry (attempt 2, exit 1) and model_execute.json a successful attempt 4; per codex/claim_state.json these are operational facts with no scientific meaning and are not treated here as evidence of anything. The MEASUREMENT_INVALID status in this audit is a design-and-transmission verdict about the frozen experiment, not an infrastructure failure and not a falsification.
baseline_findings: B-NULL-INSTRUMENT: expected REJECT, observed REJECT, PASS as recorded, but the control is uninformative by construction. estimators.py:292-294 is `return 0.0`, identical in behaviour to NC-CONSTANT-ZERO, so its REJECT only demonstrates that a constant is a constant. IVC_DELTA_STATISTIC_B-NULL-INSTRUMENT=0.0 and IVC_MIN_PERMUTATION_P_B-NULL-INSTRUMENT=1.0 are both forced (all 1,000 permutation draws equal the observed value). Audited: PASS-as-recorded / ZERO INFORMATION.

NC-CONSTANT-ZERO: expected REJECT, observed REJECT, PASS as recorded, same defect as B-NULL-INSTRUMENT. This is the packet's designated null control for the contract's own null (prereg.md section 7), and it is a duplicate of B-NULL-INSTRUMENT, so the null control does not test the null. Audited: PASS-as-recorded / ZERO INFORMATION. This is the same failure mode codex/claim_state.json already recorded for EXP-PHYSICS-36279239922's B-INDEPENDENT-REGIME-NULL.

B-IDENTITY-CHANNEL: expected ACCEPT, observed REJECT, recorded pass=false. Audited: the case is mis-specified twice over. First, prereg.md section 7 and spec.json baselines define B-IDENTITY-CHANNEL as a treatment CHANNEL, but it is implemented and reported as an estimator (estimators.py:297-308 returns |Pearson r| between treatment and target). Second, that statistic is a correlation coefficient in [-1,1] and is compared against a channel MI in bits (IVC_CHANNEL_MI_CH-IDENTITY=1.9491083554306654), a unit mismatch of the same class as V2/RF14. Its REJECT is a units artifact and carries no information about the contract's ability to accept maximum signal. Audited: FAIL (mis-specified baseline, not a contract false positive).

B-SHUFFLED-CHANNEL: expected REJECT, observed REJECT, recorded pass=true. Audited: REJECT is correct, but the case is not the preregistered baseline. IVC_CHANNEL_MI_CH-SHUFFLED = 0.1880049864679197, not the preregistered 0.0, so the null channel is not null; a global permutation of the latent still yields 0.16575614127138782 bits, so most of the 0.188 is plug-in finite-sample bias. It is also the only case in the battery that fails the metamorphic-invariance test (IVC_INVARIANCE_PASSED_B-SHUFFLED-CHANNEL=false), which is a pooled-correlation/units artifact rather than a validity signal. Audited: REJECT correct / BASELINE INVALID as a null.

PC-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD: expected ACCEPT, observed REJECT, recorded pass=false. Audited: not a positive control. estimators.py:322-324 is `return kg_runtime_header_jaccard(data)`, so the case is bit-identical in construction to KG-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD and contributes no independent evidence; the only difference in the reported numbers (1.7711598936776587 vs 1.771066334482052) is RNG call-order drift. It also does not implement the prereg.md section 6.1 estimator (header-only Jaccard); no Jaccard computation exists in the packet. Audited: FAIL (vacuous positive control, duplicated case).

KG-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD: expected ACCEPT, observed REJECT, recorded pass=false. Audited: this is the only case in the battery that carries real information, and it is informative in the producer's favour on one point and against the producer's conclusion on another. In favour: the contract does reject it while its permutation p is at the floor (0.000999000999000999), so the displacement test is not trivially failing on p. Against the conclusion: the estimator returned exactly the channel MI (1.9491083554306654 = IVC_CHANNEL_MI_CH-IDENTITY), i.e. it was perfectly calibrated, and was REJECTed solely because delta = |stat_test - E_null| = 1.7709 < 1.9491. Per RF14 the frozen threshold makes ACCEPT unreachable for any calibrated estimator, so this case does not establish a false positive of the contract; it establishes that the frozen acceptance criterion cannot be satisfied. Audited: REJECT is an artifact of the frozen criterion, not evidence of contract misbehaviour.

KB-PHYSICS-CMI: expected REJECT, observed REJECT, recorded pass=true. Audited: the REJECT is well-founded but the case does not test the Codex estimator. estimators.py:32-115 is a fresh re-implementation (prereg.md section 5.1 and the mandate's codex dependency both forbid this) whose defect faithfully mirrors the parent: K_per_stratum keyed by C only (line 66) with the (C,R) guard skipping every cell (line 100-101), so H_CR is identically 0.0 and cmi = H_C. The residual IVC_DELTA_STATISTIC_KB-PHYSICS-CMI = 3.3306690738754696e-16 is a floating-point artifact of that summation, and the preregistered bitwise-invariance criterion would have registered it as a change while np.isclose did not. The retrievable Codex artifact research/experiments/EXP-PHYSICS-36279239922/execute_calibration_v3.py (sha256 19e44d27bc6b089a3a5297396c1bb97887cf6f65c74cf211a4555ab6570bc0e4) exists and matches the prereg citation but was never executed. Audited: PASS-as-recorded / CASE NOT THE CODEX ESTIMATOR. A re-implementation with the same key mismatch on different data is consistent with the Codex account and is a legitimate bounded observation, but it is not a certification of the recorded statistic.

KB-PRODUCT-COLD: expected REJECT, observed REJECT, recorded pass=true.
